item.title: Amazon Opens Massive Cross Dock Facility in Desert Hot Springs
item.description: A ribbon-cutting ceremony marked the opening of one of the largest industrial facilities in Desert Hot Springs — a new 635,000-square-foot inbound cross dock operated by Amazon.The facility serves as a key entry point for products entering Amazon’s distribution network. Instead of long-term storage, shipments arrive at the site where they are scanned, sorted, and quickly reloaded onto outbound trucks headed to fulfillment centers. item.title: Can Burning the Candle at Both Ends Raise Your Risk of Heart Problems?
item.description: A new study highlights the hidden risks of chronic sleep deprivation for men in their 50s. Researchers found that middle-aged men who skimp on sleep are more likely to develop atrial fibrillation (AFib), a potentially serious irregular heartbeat that can increase the risk of stroke.
